source.title: Forgiveness
source.description:
Alexandros Mograine was murdered by his son and the weight of that betrayal is a shackle around his very soul. The Ashbringer was as much the man as the sword itself, and the blade will not find peace until the spirit of Alexandros himself does. Take the weapon to the Scarlet Monastery cathedral in Tirisfal Glades. Once there confront Mograine's son, the Scarlet Commander.

Mograine must find the will to forgive for this to truly end.
source.objective: Travel to the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Enter the monastery's cathedral while wielding the Corrupted Ashbringer and bear witness to what occurs there.
source.completion:
<The spirit doesn't speak, and indeed seems not even to notice your presence.>

<Your heart sinks at the implications of what just happened. What will become of Alexandros now? What of the redemption of the Ashbringer? You have so many questions, and even fewer answers.>

<Attempts to call upon the Will of the Ashbringer using the blade are only met with silence now.>
